name: Barber Shop Uncut
review:
A visit to Monsieur Stache's old-school barbershop on 40 lines. Winning symbols lock in place and trigger respins, giving you more chances to add to a win, and the bonus offers free spins.

Medium volatility, a 2,355x cap and a strong 97.0% RTP make it one of the better-balanced games in Thunderkick's catalogue. Charming and steady.
pros: Excellent 97.00% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
